statement: A running model, not a calibrated one. Nearly every number is carried over from the original prototype or chosen so that the model can run; none has been measured on a plant. Use its output to compare scenarios and to show what a design implies, not to predict dates, sizes or loads.

phenology.budburstDoy.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype starts extension growth on 5 April.

phenology.growthEndDoy.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype ends extension growth on 27 September.

phenology.leafFlushDoy.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

phenology.autumnColourDoy.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

phenology.leafFallDoy.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

phenology.floralInitiationDoy.basis: RHS: wisteria flower buds start to develop in late summer of the previous year. Taken as 1 August to 15 September; no dated source.

phenology.flowerOpenDoy.basis: Placed inside the RHS flowering envelope of May to June (1 to 15 May). The prototype opened flowers from 18 April.

phenology.petalFallDoy.basis: Placed inside the RHS flowering envelope of May to June (26 May to 15 June). The prototype dropped petals from 19 May.

extension.leaderMPerSeason.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

extension.lateralMPerSeasonByOrder.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

extension.whipMPerSeason.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

extension.establishmentFactorByYear.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

architecture.trunkStemStartYears.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype starts three trunk stems at -0.95, 0.15 and 1.1 seasons; the first is the nursery cane.

architecture.nurseryCaneM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. Length the first stem had reached by planting day in the prototype.

architecture.maxBranchOrder.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

architecture.leaderLengthM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype plans 5 to 6.5 m beyond the eave, after about 2.1 m of rib leg.

architecture.lateralLengthMByOrder.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. Midpoints of the prototype ranges 2.4-4.4, 1.2-2.6 and 0.6-1.4 m.

architecture.lateralLengthSpread.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. Each lateral is planned at its midpoint length give or take this fraction.

architecture.lateralChanceByParentOrder.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

architecture.budExtraDormancyChance.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

architecture.budExtraDormancyYears.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

architecture.maxStemsPerRoute.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype allows two stems per diagonal or cable and three per eave beam.

architecture.maxStemsPerPrimaryMember.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype runs three trunk stems up one rib leg.

routing.occupancyCost.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

routing.downhillCostPerM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

routing.uphillBonusPerM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

routing.straightOnBonus.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

routing.riserBonus.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

routing.tierBonus.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

routing.roleDropChance.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

routing.noise.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

routing.giveUpCost.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

attachment.maxGraspDiameterMm.basis: Stands in for the unmeasured grasp limit. The prototype has trunk stems twining a 100 x 180 mm rib leg (178 mm round) unaided, so the limit is taken to be just above that. Measure on real plants before relying on it.

attachment.minPitchM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype coils cables at a pitch of 0.24 to 0.36 m.

attachment.pitchPerCircumference.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. Reproduces the prototype pitch of about 0.82 m round the 0.56 m perimeter of a rib leg.

organs.leafSpacingM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

organs.leafLengthM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

organs.spurChance.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

organs.spurLengthM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype draws spurs 85 to 125 mm out from the stem and then down.

organs.spurLeafCount.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

organs.racemeLengthM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. Within the RHS description of racemes to about 30 cm.

organs.whipShareOfNodes.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

organs.whipsPerYearMax.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

organs.whipLengthM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

organs.clearStemHeightM.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype keeps the trunk bare on the rib leg, up to the eave at about 2.05 m.

flowering.competenceYears.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype first flowers in the fourth year.

flowering.maturityRamp.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

flowering.spurFloralChance.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

flowering.unprunedFactor.basis: RHS: summer pruning encourages flower buds over leafy growth. The size of the effect is not given anywhere; one half is a placeholder chosen so that the difference shows.

pruning.summerLeavesKept.basis: RHS: in July or August cut the whippy green shoots of the current year back to five or six leaves.

pruning.winterBudsKept.basis: RHS: in January or February cut the same growths back to two or three buds.

thickening.tipRadiusSquaredMm2.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.

thickening.radiusSquaredPerMetreMm2.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured. The prototype adds 2.6e-5 m2 of radius squared per metre of stem carried.

thickening.branchShare.basis: Carried over from the Wisteria prototype (docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AUDIT.md section 2.4). Not measured.
